step.cmd: In NWS and ACS, determine if any attempts have been made to contact the employer:

ul.li: If no, go to step 12.
If yes, go to step 14.

step.cmd: Fact-find with the person who issued the ROE to obtain the missing information:

ul.li: If the employer was reached, go to step 13.
If the employer was not reached, go to step 14.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select ROE .
Comments: Type “ROE correction.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Select Save .
Go to step 22

step.cmd: In ACS, determine if letters were already sent to this employer for this ROE:

ul.li: If no letters were sent to this employer, go to step 15.

If a first Z-02-00-00 letter has been sent, determine if 10 business days have passed since the letter was sent:
If no, go to step 16.
If yes, go to step 17.

If a second Z-02-00-00 letter has been sent, determine if 10 business days have passed since it was sent:
If no, go to step 19.
If yes, go to step 21.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the Z-02-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Employer or Third Party Name (1334)
Employer or Third Party Address 1 (1336)

Opening Sentence to ER re: Request or Clarify ROE/RFS (2794)
Request ROE Opening Sentence - claimant

Request for a Record of Employment (2797)
Request for Additional ROE Information
Text - Free Text (1612): Enter the following information: issue you are inquiring about, your telephone number and work hours (in the employer’s time zone, if necessary) and the date which the information is required.
Blank / Contact officer / Contact by phone or mail (11326)
Indicate on letter how letter mailed (2804)

step.cmd: In NWS, move the ROE Correction WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Z-02-00-00 letter sent.”
Bring forward date: Enter the date the letter is sent + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if the information has been obtained from the employer:

ul.li: If no, go to step 18.
If yes, go to 23.

step.cmd: In ACS, send a registered copy of the Z-02-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Employer or Third Party Name (1334)
Employer or Third Party Address 1 (1336)

Opening Sentence to ER re: Request or Clarify ROE/RFS (2794)
Request ROE Opening Sentence - claimant

Request for a Record of Employment (2797)
Follow-up Request for ROE Additional Information
Date contacted employer (1556)
Enclosing a copy of letter (2800)
Date of BF (1540): Enter the date the letter is sent + 10 business days.
Blank / Contact officer / Contact by phone or mail (11326)

Attachment List for Z-02-00-00 (3133):
Copy of original letter

Indicate on letter how letter mailed (2804)
Sent by Registered mail .

step.cmd: In NWS, move the ROE Correction WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Z-02-00-00 letter sent.”
Bring forward date: Enter the date the letter is sent + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if the information has been obtained:

ul.li: If no, go to step 21.
If yes, go to step 22.

step.cmd: In RCM, determine which blocks of the ROE are in error and consult ROE: RCM validation error correction for a regular ROE — Instructions and ROE: RCM validation error correction for a regular ROE (employer not reached) — Instructions to determine how to correct the ROE.

ul.li: If the corrections can be made with the information on file, go to step 22.
If the corrections cannot be made with the information on file, go to Actioning the ROE error when there is employer non-compliance. Actioning the ROE error when there is employer non-compliance.
